name: review-domain
job: Review a product or ops domain into one assessment record with severity-ranked findings and recommended actions.

inScope: Framing subject, surfaces, users, and success criteria
Opening one domain pack matching the review ask
Gathering evidence and separating fact, inference, and unknown
Producing one ranked findings and actions record
outOfScope: Implementing the fix unless scope expands
Multiple domain packs for a single-domain ask
Domain checklists as separate listing skills

inputs: Subject and domain of the assessment
Evidence sources per the domain pack
failureSemantics: Findings separate fact, inference, and unknown; a review record without ranked severity or residuals is incomplete, and domain checklists never become separate listing skills.

outcome.observable: One domain review record with severity-ranked findings, residuals, and recommended actions that a decision owner can act on, produced from one matching domain pack.
